records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Engaged enough to attend the onboarding call on day 3 [calendar:cf2338ae] after the welcome email [email:8d8112ae], but 6 days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone and zero replies or tickets; 8 days left. Active Pro subscription is a mild positive signal.

draft.subject: Following up on our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call last week. I wanted to check in as you get Bright Partners set up in Wrenfield.

A good first step is creating a project -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that came up after our call.

Best,
Chidi
